extracted.name: Buffalo Seitan Bites
extracted.description: Great recipe for Buffalo Seitan Bites.
ingredient_lines: Mix all and form a ball. Let rest 20 minutes
1 cup milk of choice(I used almond milk)
instruction_lines: To make Seitan: Mix all and form a ball. Let rest 20 minutes. Form a log then cut in thirds then halves then halved again. Press flat. Put on a cookie sheet lined with parchment. Cover will foul tightly. Put in a 350 degree oven for 10 minutes then flip them and put in for another 10 minutes. Remove and let cool.
Combine milk and hot sauce. Dredge seitan in flour then milk mixture and repeat. Sauté in hot pan for a few minutes until warmed through. Add more hot sauce to serve.
